ACTION MEMO
  TRAFFIC SAFETY COMMITTEE
  MEETING

Council Chambers - City Hall  Wednesday
340 Palos Verdes Drive West  June 11, 2014
Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274  7:30 PM

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL  Committee Members Beall, Garland, Vice-Chair King, and Chairman Buss present.
  Committee Member Kao absent.

COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC
 Speeding on Via Olivera between Via Coronel and Via Estudillo – Peter Kim

  Action:  Traffic Safety Committee declined to agendize item.

OLD BUSINESS
1. Palos Verdes Drive West Install Additional Speed Limit Signs and Markings.

  Traffic Safety Committee member Beall moved (seconded by Traffic Safety Committee Vice-
  Chair King) to recommend that Staff: 1) Construct three new radar speed feedback sign
  foundations on PVDW and include these locations in the citywide rotation program; 2)
  Relocate the existing eastbound 25 mph sign on PVDW easterly to Via Del Puente; 3) Replace
  12 existing 24” x 30” 35 mph speed limit signs on PVDW with 30” x 36” signs; 4) Install three
  new 35 mph speed limit signs on PVDW; and, 5) Install 23 “35” pavement markings at 14
  locations on PVDW. All locations for these items are as determined by the City Traffic
  Engineer. The vote was 4 in favor (Kao absent).

NEW BUSINESS
2. Palos Verdes Drive West Upper Barrel Modify Striping and Markings.
